title: Interview debrief for the support specialist role
text:
Nora: We saw three candidates for the support specialist role this week. Let's go through the scores first.
Felix: I scored the first candidate highest on the written exercise. Clear answers, kind tone.
Gwen: Same for me. Their reply to the angry customer was the best of the three.
Nora: The second candidate?
Felix: Strong on the product but slow on the exercise. They ran out of time.
Gwen: I liked how they asked questions before answering, though.
Nora: And the third?
Felix: Friendly, but the answers had several mistakes about billing.
Gwen: I agree. Billing questions are a large share of our tickets, so that matters.
Nora: So the first candidate leads. Any concerns about them?
Felix: Only that they have not used our ticketing tool. That is easy to learn.
Gwen: No concerns from me.
Nora: Then I will ask for references and prepare an offer. If they decline, we talk to the second candidate again.
Felix: Should we ask the second one for another exercise with more time?
Nora: Only if the offer is declined. Thanks for the careful notes, both of you.
